abilities.name: Lead From the Front
abilities.description: You may use Call Out on an allied Digimon instead of your own partner. When you do, that Digimon gains the normal bonus from Call Out to their next attack this round. Lead From the Front still uses your Free Action, just like a normal use of Call Out. This does not replace or prevent you from using Call Out on your own Digimon; you may still use Call Out normally on your partner, and all bonuses that apply when using Lead From the Front also apply when using Call Out.

abilities.name: Burning Courage
abilities.description: Once per round, you may use Lead From the Front as its own action. This use does not use your Free Action, allowing you to use Lead From the Front twice on the same Digimon in a single round: once normally by spending your Free Action, and once using Lead From the Front as its own action.

abilities.name: Constant Call
abilities.description: Whenever you use Call Out, the Digimon benefiting from it adds your Courage rank to the attack roll instead of the normal +1 bonus.

abilities.name: No Retreat
abilities.description: When your Digimon hits 0 HP while above Default Stage, before the cascade triggers you may spend 5 Hope to keep them at 1 HP and hold their current stage until the end of the round.

abilities.name: Push the Limit
abilities.description: Your Digimon may digivolve up to 3 stages above Default Stage instead of the normal 2 stage maximum. The Hope costs and corruption rules still apply.

abilities.name: Rally the Team
abilities.description: When you use Lead From the Front, you may choose up to 3 allied Digimon instead of one.
